ORAL ORDER (PER : HONOURABLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE MRS. JUSTICE SUNITA AGARWAL)
1.

By means of the present petition, the petitioner herein is seeking to challenge the award passed by the competent authority, under the Land Acquisition Act dated 26.03.2014 in Land Acquisition Case No.246 of 2011, on the grounds that with the coming into force of the Right to Fair Compensation Thakor Thakarshibhai Vahjibhai vs State Of Gujarat on 8 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/124786793/
1 and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, ("the Act' 2013"
in short) with effect from 01.01.2014, the market value of the land in question could not have been determined with reference to the date of acquisition Notification under section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 ("the Act' 1894).

The error NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/20544/2023 ORDER DATED: 08/12/2023 undefined in the award dated 26.03.2014 is of the date of determination of market value for making award under RFCLTLARR Act' 2013, when land acquisition proceeding though initiated under the Land Acquisition Act'1894 but award had not been declared prior to repeal of the said Act' 1894 w.e.f. 01.01.2014.
2.

To deal with the contentions herein, we are required to go through the provisions of Section 24 of the Act' 2013, which reads as under:-
"Section 24 Land acquisition process under Act No. 1 of 1984 shall be deemed to have lapsed in certain cases.

(1) Notwithstanding anything contained in this Act, in any case of land acquisition proceedings initiated under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894,
(a) where no award under section 11 of the said Land Acquisition Act has been made,
then, all provisions of this Act relating to the determination of compensation shall apply; or (b) where an award under said section 11 has been made, then such proceedings shall continue under the provisions of the said Land Acquisition Act, as if the said Act has not been repealed.

(2) Notwithstanding anything contained in sub- section (1), in case of land acquisition proceedings initiated under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (1 of 1894), where an award under the said section 11 has been made five years or more prior to the commencement of this Act but the physical possession of the land has not been taken or the compensation has not been paid NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/20544/2023 ORDER DATED:
08/12/2023 undefined the said proceedings shall be deemed to have lapsed and the appropriate Government, if it so chooses, shall initiate the proceedings of such land acquisition afresh in accordance with the provisions of this Act:
Provided that where an award has been made and compensation in respect of a majority of land holdings has not been deposited in the account of the beneficiaries,
then, all beneficiaries specified in the notification for acquisition under section 4 of the said Land Acquisition Act, shall be entitled to compensation in accordance with the provisions of this Act."
3. A careful reading of Clause (a) of sub-section(1) of Section 24 indicates that in cases where the land acquisition proceedings were initiated under the Act' 1894 and no award under Section 11 of Thakor Thakarshibhai Vahjibhai vs State Of Gujarat on 8 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/124786793/

sentences.text: 2 the said Act had been made, the provisions of the Act' 2013 relating to determination of compensation shall apply.
The result would be that all elements of determination of compensation under the Act' 2013 have to be taken into consideration while making the award.
We may further note the provisions of section 26(1), which provides the criteria in assessing and determining the market value of the land.

Proviso to Sub-section (1) of section 26 reads that the date for determination of market value shall be the date on which the notification has been issued under Section 11 of the Act' 2013, which is the preliminary notification intimating the intention of the appropriate Government NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/20544/2023 ORDER DATED: 08/12/2023 undefined to acquire any land for public purposes.

Similar is the provision under Section 23 of the Act' 1894, where sub-section (1) of Section 23 provides for determination of market value on the date of publication of the notification under Sub-section (1) of Section 4.
4.

The transitional phase, as contemplated in section 24, where the land acquisition proceedings though initiated under the Act' 1894, but could not be completed with the making of the award under Section 11 of the said Act, has been dealt with under sub- section (1)(a) of Section 24, as noted hereinabove.

The Act' 2013, however, is silent about the situation which is before us, i.e. as to the date of determination of the market value of the land, while making award under section 24(1)(a) in an acquisition, wherein proceedings have been initiated under the Act'1894.

This situation has been dealt with by the Central Government in the Notification dated 26.10.2015.
5.

It is a settled position as per the decision of the Allahabad High Court in the case of Kanti Devi and 7 others vs. State of U.P and 4 others passed on 12th July, 2023 in Writ-C No.57053 of 2017,
which reads as under:
" 20.

Ministry of Rural Development, copy of which was forwarded to all Principal Secretaries of the States/UTs for information and necessary action, the issues raised by the Government of Maharashtra for calculation of market value under Section 24(1)(a) has been resolved as under:-
S.No. Issues raised by the Government of Maharashtra Opinion of the DoLR 1.

While determining the amount of compensation under Section 27 of the RFCTLAR&R Act, 2013 of Hon'ble Supreme Court's orders are followed or cost of assets have to be separately computed in addition to cost of land?

Thus, it is not contradictory to the Supreme Court's orders quoted in the letter of Maharashtra Government.
2. Under Section 24(1), the reference date for calculating 12% interest should be date of preliminary notification under Land Acquisition Act, 1894.

Under section 24(1), the reference date for calculating 12% interest should be date of preliminary notification under Land Acquisition Act,
1894.
Department of Land Resources agrees to this, as there is no other reference date, that can be treated as equivalent to date of SIA notification under the RFCTLAR&R Act, 2013.

3. For calculation of market value, under Section 24(1)(a), reference date should be 01.01.2014 (commencement of RFCTLAR&R Act, 2013) or date of NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/20544/2023 ORDER DATED: 08/12/2023 undefined issuing preliminary notification under Land Acquisition Act, 1894?

The reference date for calculation of market value, under Section 24(1)(a) should be 01.01.2014 (commencement of RFCTLAR&R Act, 2013), as the Section reads "in any case of land acquisition proceedings initiated under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, where no award under section 11 of the said Land Acquisition Act has been made, then, all provisions of this Act relating to the determination of compensation shall apply.

Under section 26 reference date is date of preliminary notification, but section 24 is a special case of application of the Act in retrospective cases, and a later date of determination of market value is suggested (i.e. 01.01.2014) with a view to ensure that the land owners/farmers/affected families get enhanced compensation under the provisions of the RFCTLAR&R Act, 2013 (as also recommended by Standing Committee in its 31st report).
21.

From a perusal of the D.O. letter dated 26th October, 2015, issued by the concerned Ministry of the Central Government forwarded to the Principal Secretary of the State of U.P., for information and necessary action, it is evident that the said direction was made in order to remove difficulty arose in giving effect to the provisions of the RFCTLARR Act, 2013, in the matter of calculation of market value under Section 24(1)(a), in the land acquisition proceedings initiated under the Act,
1894.

The said directions issued by the Central Government being in exercise of the power under Section 113 of the RFCTLARR Act, 2013 have statutory force and are binding on all the State Government being in view of the power conferred on the Central Government to make such provision or give such directions which are not inconsistent with the provisions of the RFCTLARR Act, 2013, for removal of any difficulty arising in giving effect to the provisions of the RFCTLARR Act, 2013.

22. In view of the statutory character of the D.O. letter dated 26th October, 2015, it is evident that the reference date for calculation of market value under NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/20544/2023 ORDER DATED: 08/12/2023 undefined Section 24(1)(a) should be 1.1.2014, the date of commencement of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

4 notification but Section 24 is the special case of application of the Act, 2013 in retrospective cases and a later date of determination of market value, i.e. 1.1.2014 is suggested with a view to ensure that the land owners/farmers/affected families get enhanced compensation under the provisions of the RFCTLARR Act, 2013, in terms of the recommendation of the Standing Committee in its 31st report."
6.

sentences.text: Mr. K.M. Antani, learned Assistant Government Pleader appearing for the State respondent could not dispute the submissions made by the learned counsel for the petitioners with regard to the date of determination of market value.

7. In view of the above, we are of the considered opinion that any award, which is passed in the land acquisition proceedings after coming into force of the Act' 2013 though acquisition proceedings have been initiated under the Act' 1894, the date of determination of market value of the acquired land shall be the date of enforcement of the Act' 2013, which is 01.01.2014.

The result is that the impugned award, which has been passed taking into consideration of the date of NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/20544/2023 ORDER DATED: 08/12/2023 undefined determination of the market value as the date of publication of notification under section 4(1) of the Act' 1894 is liable to be set aside.

8. While setting aside the award, we remit the matter for fresh consideration before the Special Land Acquisition Officer/respondent No.3 for making a fresh award keeping in mind the observations made hereinabove, determining the market value of the land in question as on 01.01.2014.
All other elements of compensation as per the Act' 2013 shall be determined on adjudication on the question of market value.
The proceedings for making of the award shall be completed within the period of six weeks from the date of receipt of the copy of the order.
9. With above directions and observations, the writ petition is allowed.
